title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Red Hulk, Bigfoot, Aliens, Giant Mutant Crab, and More Hidden Secrets

content:
GTA 6 has only been out for a few days, and players are already discovering some absolutely ridiculous secrets hidden across Leonida. From a farmer turning into a Red Hulk-like monster to Bigfoot wandering through the swamps, Rockstar has packed its latest open-world game with bizarre encounters.

There are also alien abductions, a giant mutant crab, references to popular TV shows, and even a house that seemingly questions whether the entire game is a simulation.

Some discoveries have already been documented by multiple players, while others remain mysteries that the community is still trying to figure out.

Here are some of the craziest GTA 6 Easter eggs and hidden secrets discovered so far.

Last Updated November 22, 2026.

In Brief

  • GTA 6 features a Red Hulk-like mutant, Bigfoot sightings, and a giant crab monster hidden in Leonida.
  • Players have discovered a UFO abduction encounter near Port Gellhorn and a recreation of Dexter Morgan’s apartment in Vice City.
  • A mysterious house first teased in 2021 contains a hidden conspiracy about living inside a simulation.
  • Reports of an underwater Kraken and an apparently immortal NPC are circulating, although their exact nature remains unconfirmed.
  • Players have discovered UFO encounters, a hidden alien research facility, a strange beach merman, and a recreation of Dexter Morgan’s apartment in Vice City.

1. Red Hulk Easter Egg in GTA 6

One of the strangest Easter eggs discovered in GTA 6 involves a farmer who transforms into something resembling Marvel’s Red Hulk.

The encounter happens during a side quest where players help a farmer grow unusually large strawberries.

Things take a turn when the farmer starts experimenting with questionable chemicals.

Instead of simply producing bigger strawberries, the experiment transforms him into a massive, red-skinned mutant with an appearance similar to Red Hulk.

Rockstar’s Rob Nelson explained that the studio enjoys including these kinds of strange encounters when developers come up with entertaining ideas.

While the character looks like Red Hulk, it’s a parody-style reference rather than an official Marvel crossover.

If you thought the Red Hulk encounter was strange, GTA 6 also has a giant mutant crab that can attack players.

The creature has been spotted during an encounter inside a building in Gullet Marsh, where a huge, mutated crab suddenly appears.

Its enormous claws, bulging eyes, and disturbing appearance make it one of the creepiest creatures discovered in the game so far.

Some players believe the monster could be connected to the mysterious crab research facility in Pelican Valley, although that connection hasn’t been confirmed.

Interestingly, the encounter may also reference the infamous giant enemy crab meme from Sony’s E3 2006 presentation.

If you’re interested in the possible connection, we’ve already covered the Pelican Valley secret research puzzle, including all passwords, safe codes, and the hidden Crabshack VF5 SMG.

3. Bigfoot Returns in GTA 6

After years of Bigfoot rumors and mysteries throughout the Grand Theft Auto series, the legendary creature has made its way into GTA 6.

Players have reported encountering a Bigfoot-like creature, also known as the Skunk Ape, in the wilderness around Gambit Bay and the wetlands of Leonida.

One reported sighting occurs near Old Fort Road, where the creature can be seen crossing a dirt road.

If you follow it into the woods, you’ll eventually discover a disturbing effigy. Investigating it causes your character to black out and wake up elsewhere.

There is also a dedicated Skunk Ape side quest involving a character named Kirk, giving players more opportunities to investigate the creature.

Rockstar has kept the mystery playful, leaving players to wonder what exactly they’re dealing with.

4. GTA 6’s Secret House Suggests Everything Is a Simulation

This might be one of Rockstar’s most interesting long-running Easter eggs.

Back in 2021, players noticed a mysterious photograph of a house in GTA: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition.

The building didn’t appear to match any familiar location from previous GTA games, leading fans to speculate that Rockstar had secretly teased GTA 6 years before its official reveal.

Now, players have discovered that exact house in Belville, Leonida.

However, the house has another secret.

Inside its garage, players can find a conspiracy theorist’s hideout filled with unusual notes, diagrams, and references to video game mechanics.

One message prominently reads:

“IT’S A SIMULATION.”

The garage suggests its occupant believes they’re trapped inside a video game.

It’s a clever fourth-wall-breaking Easter egg, especially considering how long fans have been investigating the house.

If you’re looking to explore more hidden interiors, check out our guide on how to find buildings you can enter using the GTA 6 map.

5. Dexter Morgan’s Apartment and Boat in Vice City

Fans of the television series Dexter might recognize another hidden location in GTA 6.

Players have discovered an apartment complex on Washington Island in Vice Beach that appears to reference Dexter Morgan’s home.

The location features several recognizable details from the show, including suspicious equipment on the rooftop.

Nearby, players can also find a boat resembling Dexter’s famous Slice of Life.

The apartment complex is known as Trinity Apartments, which could be another reference to the series and its infamous Trinity Killer.

Considering the game’s Florida-inspired setting, the Dexter Easter egg fits naturally into Vice City’s world.

6. Secret Alien Abduction Easter Egg Near Port Gellhorn

Aliens have been part of Grand Theft Auto mysteries for years, and GTA 6 continues that tradition.

Players have discovered a UFO encounter in the wilderness east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.

The encounter reportedly becomes available after Chapter 1 and can be triggered at night.

To find it, look for a suspicious abandoned vehicle with flashing lights along a dirt road near the motel.

Following the nearby trail leads toward a strange blue glow in the woods, where a UFO encounter takes place.

The event can also reward players with the hidden “The Truth Is Out There” trophy.

Interestingly, this UFO encounter appears to be connected to an even bigger secret involving an underground alien research facility. Players have reported a follow-up dream sequence and a mission to rescue an extraterrestrial being from captivity. We’ve covered the discovery and its reported location further below.

7. A Giant Kraken May Be Hiding Underwater in GTA 6

Another mysterious discovery involves what appears to be a gigantic sea creature lurking beneath the waters surrounding Leonida.

Footage shared by players shows a massive, tentacled shape resting on the ocean floor.

The creature resembles a Kraken, the legendary sea monster often depicted as an enormous squid or octopus.

However, the discovery is still being investigated.

It’s currently unclear whether the object is an actual creature, part of a scripted Easter egg, or simply something resembling a monster in the underwater environment.

There also isn’t a widely verified location or reliable method for triggering an encounter.

The GTA 6 Kraken remains one of the game’s more intriguing unconfirmed mysteries.

8. GTA 6’s Mysterious Immortal Man

Players have also shared footage of a particularly creepy NPC who seemingly refuses to die.

In the reported encounter, a man survives attacks that would normally kill an ordinary pedestrian.

The footage shows him repeatedly getting back up after being attacked.

Things become even stranger when the NPC appears to stare directly toward the player through a sniper scope from a considerable distance.

Some players believe this could be a deliberate supernatural Easter egg, while others suspect unusual NPC behavior or a gameplay bug.

There’s currently no confirmed explanation for the encounter or a reliable location where players can reproduce it.

Still, it’s exactly the kind of creepy mystery that has made Rockstar’s open-world games so popular among Easter egg hunters.

9. Secret Merman Easter Egg Near Key Lento in GTA 6

GTA 6 players have discovered another bizarre Easter egg involving a man dressed as a mermaid on a secluded beach.

The encounter, which some players are calling the “Feminine Marman,” can be found on a small island near Shores Keys, northeast of Key Lento.

As shown in NOBELL’s Easter egg location post, the character can be seen relaxing on the sand while wearing a bright turquoise mermaid tail.

Despite his appearance, he isn’t an actual sea creature. He’s simply a man dressed as a mermaid.

Other players have documented a photoshoot setup at the location, complete with a camera and tripod. The man even interacts with players and reacts when they interrupt his filming.

It’s another example of Rockstar’s strange sense of humor, and one of the more unusual encounters hidden around the Leonida Keys.

10. GTA 6’s Secret Area 51 Alien Research Facility

It turns out the UFO encounter near Port Gellhorn might only be the beginning of GTA 6’s alien mystery.

Players have discovered what appears to be a secret government research facility containing an extraterrestrial creature.

A newly shared location screenshot points toward an area south of Hamlet, near Pelican Valley.

The accompanying footage shows a small, grey alien lying on a medical examination table inside a mysterious underground laboratory.

According to community walkthroughs, this facility is connected to a larger alien storyline involving the UFO encounter near the Starlet Motel.

After experiencing the initial encounter and a subsequent dream sequence, players can reportedly access a restricted research facility and rescue an alien being held inside.

Completing the secret storyline is also reported to reward players with permanent increases to their maximum Health, Stamina, and Focus.

However, guides currently disagree on the facility’s precise entrance, with several placing it at South Point Airfield. The marker in the shared screenshot should therefore be treated as an approximate location until the entrance is independently verified.

Either way, the discovery suggests Rockstar has hidden a much larger alien mystery in GTA 6 than players initially expected.

These are only some of the Easter eggs players have found since GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026.

Rockstar has also included smaller hidden activities, optional encounters, and collectibles that reward players for exploring Leonida.

For example, you can discover a secret toilet Easter egg that permanently increases your stamina.

There are also unique weapons that players can permanently miss, including Donnie’s secret H&L .38 revolver during the Chapter 1 mission Don Gone.

With such a massive world to explore, there’s a good chance players will continue finding new secrets for months or even years.

And considering Rockstar’s history with mysteries like Mount Chiliad, some of these discoveries could lead to even bigger surprises.
